All green. Let me update HANDOFF.md for milestone 2 and do a final verification.

{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > HANDOFF.md << 'EOF'
# cachetools milestone 2 - TaggedCache (R01-R06)

## Status: COMPLETE (public + upstream + own tests all pass)

## Implementation: src/cachetools/tagged.py
- `TaggedCache(maxsize)` wraps a private `_TaggedLRUCache(LRUCache)`; 1 slot
  per value. maxsize validated positive int, bool excluded (ValueError).
- `put(key, value, tags=())`: tags validated/normalized FIRST (bare str/bytes
  rejected, nonstring entries rejected, non-iterable rejected, deduplicated,
  generators consumed once) so invalid replacement leaves value/tags/recency
  unchanged. Deep-copies on input. Overwrite replaces old tag memberships and
  refreshes LRU recency (Claim-A round 1).
- `get(key, default=_SENTINEL)`: KeyError on miss, detached deep copy, refresh
  recency (nested structures fully detached - R06).
- `invalidate(tag)`: removes live tagged entries, returns count (R02).
- `invalidate_many(tags, mode='any')` (R04): mode 'any' = union, 'all' =
  intersection; empty requested tags -> 0 for either mode; returns distinct
  removed keys; invalid mode/tags -> ValueError before mutation.
- `resize(maxsize)` (R05): validates positive non-bool int first; shrinking
  evicts LRU-first via `_TaggedLRUCache._resize` (sets `_Cache__maxsize`, loops
  popitem, records evicted keys); growing never evicts; survivors keep values,
  tags, LRU order; failed resize preserves all state; `maxsize` property
  reports current capacity.
- `pop`, `clear`, `__len__`, `__contains__`, `__repr__`.
- Eviction bookkeeping: `_TaggedLRUCache.popitem` appends evicted keys to
  `_evicted`; put()/resize() prune tag maps for evicted keys (no stale
  memberships; key reuse safe).

## Superseded design notes (do NOT follow)
- 'empty all-tags matches every key' -> WRONG per R04: empty tags remove 0.
- 'resizing may flush the cache' -> WRONG per R05: resize preserves survivors.
- Round-2 note about 'absolute expiry (R07/R08)': R07/R08 are not part of the
  active requirements (no expiry feature exists in this cache); resize
  preserves entry state (value/tags/recency) as-is.

## Tests
- tests/test_tagged.py: 88 tests (R01, R02, R02-extension, R03, R04, R05, R06).
- Public: acceptance_public.py (2) PASS. Upstream: tests/ (217) PASS unchanged.

Run: `PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q`
EOF
PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q 2>&1 | tail -2"}
